note: Set A captures the key structural facts faithfully — shear web sandwich construction, the aft web extending ~50% of span from the root, skin triaxial, spar cap carbon uniaxial/pultruded carbon, edge uniaxial glass for edgewise loads, and the 6×6 stiffness/inertia matrices — while Set B omits the aft-web extent, the skin/spar laminate callouts and the matrix dimension. Set B also contains clear misreads: trailing edge reinforcement called 'unidirectional carbon' (source says unidirectional glass), a 'maximum width 4 m' and 'maximum chord width 5 m' read off axis tick labels, and three mutually inconsistent Z ranges/lengths (0–100 m, 0–120 m, 120 m) alongside an unsupported 135 m length. Set A's main faults are three invented 135 m length claims from axis readings, one misbound blue-shading claim, and one claim whose quote does not support the stated material. Both sets contain redundant duplicates and trivial 'shown in red/green' claims, but A is the more accurate and complete set.
